name: qector
description: Local, fail-closed quantum error correction tools for Claude Desktop.
long_description:
QECTOR provides a local Quantum Error Correction (QEC) tool surface for Claude Desktop. The default safe profile exposes eight stable tools for decoding, code construction, threshold sweeps, license inspection, and runtime compatibility. Every returned correction is verified against the parity-check relation H c = s (mod 2).

The default path uses local stdio and makes no network request. An explicit PyPI freshness check is available only through opt-in compatibility tool arguments; it sends no QEC workload data. Research and administrative surfaces are separate opt-in MCP servers and are not bundled into this safe Desktop extension.

python_path.title: Python interpreter (optional)
python_path.description: Absolute path to a Python 3.9-3.13 interpreter with qector-decoder-v3 installed. Leave unset to auto-resolve via the bundled launcher.

tools.name: list_code_families
tools.description: List registered quantum code families and live runtime availability.

tools.name: list_decoders
tools.description: List stable decoder classes and algorithm contracts.

tools.name: get_license_info
tools.description: Read the live offline QECTOR license tier, distance limits, and gates.

tools.name: decode_syndrome
tools.description: Decode a binary syndrome; fail unless H c = s (mod 2).

tools.name: decode_single
tools.description: Run one seeded code-capacity decode with Theorems 1 and 2 checks.

tools.name: threshold_sweep
tools.description: Run a code-capacity LER sweep with Wilson 95% intervals and a hashed JSON artifact.

tools.name: build_code_from_matrix
tools.description: Validate and build a binary parity-check matrix.

tools.name: compat_report
tools.description: Report runtime compatibility; PyPI freshness is opt-in only.
